Femmes + Thems Bike Chi Monthly Social Ride is a social group ride in Chicago, IL. Schedule: First Saturday of every month (typically); weeknight night rides and quarterly trans and gender-diverse rides too. About 5–15 miles, ~10 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @femnthembikechi the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Femmes + Thems Bike Chi Monthly Social Ride group ride

A ride for women, femme, trans and non-binary Chicagoans. Five to fifteen miles at about 10 mph, with marshals in purple vests blocking intersections. Beginners welcome; nobody gets left behind. Check the calendar for the exact date and start.
